prompt:
Which dependencies are implied by the stated FD set? Select all that apply.

```formula
F = {A → B, BC → D}
where
F: a set of functional dependencies (FDs)
A, B, C, D: attributes
BC: the set {B, C}: B and C together
→: functionally determines: rows that agree on the left side agree on the right side
{ }: a set
F⁺: (in the question) every FD that follows logically from F
In words: A fixes B; B and C together fix D. Options denote attribute sets by letters side by side, so AC → BD means {A, C} → {B, D}.
```

options.text:
```formula
AC → D
where
D: the schema’s attribute names
AC: the attribute set containing A, C
→: functional determination; equal left values require equal right values
In words: A together with C fixes D.
```
options.explanation: Correct. A gives B; together with the initial C, this gives D. This is pseudotransitivity.

options.text:
```formula
A → D
where
A, D: the schema’s attribute names
→: functional determination; equal left values require equal right values
In words: A alone fixes D.
```
options.explanation: A reaches only itself and B. The dependency deriving D also needs C, which cannot be obtained.

options.text:
```formula
AC → BD
where
AC: the attribute set containing A, C
BD: the attribute set containing B, D
→: functional determination; equal left values require equal right values
In words: A together with C fixes both B and D.
```
options.explanation: Correct. Starting from A and C reaches all four attributes, including both requested right-side attributes.

options.text:
```formula
B → D
where
B, D: the schema’s attribute names
→: functional determination; equal left values require equal right values
In words: B alone fixes D.
```
options.explanation: B alone reaches only B; deriving D also requires C.

options.text:
```formula
AB → B
where
B: the schema’s attribute names
AB: the attribute set containing A, B
→: functional determination; equal left values require equal right values
In words: A together with B fixes B.
```
options.explanation: Correct. A set always determines an attribute already contained in itself; this is reflexivity.
